newsitem.title: USA: Lancit Media sets museum alliance.
newsitem.headline: Lancit Media sets museum alliance.

text.p: Ltd said it reached an agreement with the American Museum of Natural History to use its name in association with Lancit's Backyard Safari, a new natural science series for children ages four to seven.
The initial thirteen episodes of Backyard Safari are targeted to debut in early 1997. A network commitment for the series is expected to be announced shortly, Lancit said.

Under the agreement, the Museum will have the right to use the Backyard Safari logo and characters in exhibitions, events, and promotions. The Museum will continue to serve as an active consultant to Lancit on the project.
